notes: The MKR WiFi 1010 is not in the catalogue, so a new part type arduino-mkr-wifi-1010 was created. Its pin set matches the MKR 1000 pinout shown in the diagram.
The breadboard's upper half in the image is labelled rows f-j, so it is treated as bank 'b'. Columns follow the diagram: the resistor spans columns 3 to 6, and the LED legs sit in columns 6 and 8.

The LED's bent (longer) leg is taken as the anode, in column 6 with the resistor. The straight leg is the cathode, in column 8, and the black wire carries it to GND. This matches the schematic: pin 2 to resistor to LED to GND.
The green jumper goes from pin 2 to hole 3b.g, which is in the same column strip as the resistor's left leg at 3b.h.
The tutorial's software steps (WiFiNINA library, SSID and password) have no physical parts. A USB cable for power and upload is implied but not shown, so it is omitted.
